### ✨ ACECRAFT Mod Menu (v1.3.135)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **ACECRAFT: Sky Hero** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Locks CurHP to MaxHP, sets GMNoDamage & DebugModel.Invincible
- **Max Defense (999K DEF)** — Overrides PlayerLogic.DEF (AttributeType 103) to 999,999
- **Full Heal Player Now** — Instantly restores PlayerLogic.CurHP to MaxHP
- **Damage Multiplier** — Scales PlayerLogic.ATK in BattleLogicStageSystem.CalcDamage
- **Flat Bonus ATK** — Adds flat fixed-point (FP 32.32) ATK to active pilot
- **1-Hit Kill (1 HP Enemies)** — Forces MonsterLogic.CurHP to 1.0 FixD2 (raw 128) for all active enemies
- **Enemy Spawn HP Scale** — Scales newly spawned MonsterLogic.CurHP relative to MaxHP
- **Zero Enemy Defense (0 DEF)** — Sets MonsterLogic.DEF (AttributeType 103) to 0 so player hits deal full damage
- **Zero Enemy Attack (0 ATK)** — Sets MonsterLogic.ATK (AttributeType 102) to 0
- **Kill All Active Enemies** — Invokes MonsterLogic.StopScriptThenDead(true, false) on all active monsters

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
